concerns: The original cue can refer to the reception desk as well as the receptionist; narrowing it to the staff member improves alignment.
response.cue_rationale: Both answers denote the staff member handling hotel guest check-in; the original cue also permits the physical reception desk.

preference_risk.rationale: Receptionist is a plausible everyday Malaysian alternative to penyambut tetamu in hotel contexts.

response.rationale: After narrowing the cue to the hotel receptionist, Indonesian resepsionis hotel and Malaysian penyambut tetamu hotel express the same sense. The forms reflect a useful Indonesian borrowing versus a standard Malaysian Malay term.
response.risk_rationale: Malaysian hotels may also use the English-derived form receptionist, so the national preference is contextual rather than exclusive.
response.shared_synonym_rationale: Receptionist is also a plausible everyday Malaysian alternative, but penyambut tetamu remains a useful standard Malay preference rather than an artificial contrast.
